text:
oliver: Hey folks — rolling out redwood-bridges v0.1.0 to the community now. Lightweight SDK for building connector adapters (Slack, SQS, Postgres sync + custom hooks). Release notes and quickstart: https://github.com/redwood/redwood-bridges/releases/tag/v0.1.0 :tada:

dev-bot: release-bot: created release v0.1.0 · tag: v0.1.0 · 10 files changed · 3 contributors · assets attached https://github.com/redwood/redwood-bridges/releases/tag/v0.1.0

maria: This is awesome — congrats everyone! :tada:

chris: Quick Q — any breaking changes from the 0.0.x pre-release builds? need a migration plan for maintainers who tried the alpha?

oliver: No breaking surface for most users. The one change is the handler interface was renamed from `AdapterHandler` -> `BridgeHandler` (better semantics). Migration example:```python
# old
class MyHandler(AdapterHandler):
    def handle(self, event):
        pass

# new
class MyHandler(BridgeHandler):
    def handle(self, event):
        pass
```
No behavioral changes otherwise; we included a small migration guide in the release notes and compatibility shims live in `compat/` for one minor release.

emma: Can we schedule a short demo / walk-through for community maintainers? I can host 30m tomorrow 11:00am PT. Who's in?

oliver: Added a calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=bridges-demo-v0.1.0 — agenda in the invite includes quickstart, auth patterns, and example adapter. Recording will be posted.

jake: I'll put together a short tutorial notebook + docker compose example so maintainers can run a local adapter end-to-end. Will share in the repo under `examples/` by EOD.

marina: QA update: ran full adapter test matrix on `dedicated-ci` (linux, containerized) — all core tests green. Basic perf numbers: cold-start ~220ms, steady-state latency ~28ms for small payloads. Filed one minor bug (timeout handling on large payloads) — PR incoming.

oliver: Amazing, thanks. If anyone spots regressions, please open issues with label `regression` and ping @oliver. Also adding a short community announcement post and a maintainer checklist in the docs. Big thanks to everyone who shipped this! :shipit:

oliver: PS — install: `pip install redwood-bridges==0.1.0` and quick init:```bash
# create bridge project
npx redwood-bridges init my-bridge
cd my-bridge
pip install -r requirements.txt
```
